g.text: FE02 · FIND EXISTING ISSUES AND COMPARABLE BEHAVIOUR
g.title: Identify users, edge cases, documentation
Ask before creating new issue or major reframing
Code and tests in short chunks
Alternative worker, not a simultaneous editor

g.text: FE08 · PUBLISH CODE AND CI EVIDENCE
g.title: PR, checks, review threads
Independent cumulative-diff review; maintain PR metadata
Ask before creating new issue or major reframing
Code and tests in short chunks
Alternative worker, not a simultaneous editor
Independent cumulative-diff review; maintain PR metadata
